title: Research-entity registry record as published
description: One acquired record (#2579): a ROR organisation per dump release (names, types, status active/inactive/withdrawn, relationships and successor links, external identifiers as published), a public ORCID researcher record (iD, public name, last-modified time, public employments and works as asserted identifiers only), a DataCite dataset DOI (metadata version, related identifiers, funding references; personal creators reduced to ORCID iD and affiliation identifiers) or a CORDIS project (programme, participants with PIC and names, contributions with currency as published). Every record carries its provider, native revision, sortable revision order, the source's own as-of time, locator and evidence origin. Researcher records carry only the fields allowed by the RE01 minimisation decision. No record carries a ranking, a metric or an inferred affiliation.
